services.desc: Love craft beer, pub food, and catching the big game? Taproom 29 is the ultimate spot to kick back and enjoy. Grab a seat at the bar and take advantage of our wraparound cold plate, designed to keep your beer at the perfect 29-degree temperature. With a game-changing selection of 29 beers on draft, and an extensive menu featuring innovative pub fare, artisanal brick-oven pizzas, and house-made specialties, there’s something for everyone. And with 35 TVs, you can watch your favorite team from any angle, making every game day a great day at Taproom 29. $36 GOING FOR 2 Choose your lineup:2 Burgers, 2 Fries & 2 Pints of 29 Brewsor2‑Topping Pizza, 6 Wings & 2 Pints of 29 Brews one-half chicken
